title: Rabbi Polifa or Pilfi, Son of Perita

paragraphs: Rabbi Polifa — Pilfi, son of Perita.

At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:1, he raises an objection before Rabbi Yonah. Megillah 4:2 reads Pilfa. The statement also appears in tractate Soferim, chapter 21, as Rabbi Pilipa, son of Rabbi Perit. In Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:3, Rabbi Pelipa bar Perita raises an objection before Rabbi Zeira.

notes.text: Polifa, Pilfi, Pilfa, Pilipa and Pelipa are the supplied forms; Perita and Rabbi Perit also differ. The titles before the fathers are retained as supplied.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:1 reads Filippa bar Perota; Taanit 4:3 reads Filippa bar Perita. The consulted Soferim 21 reads Polipa, son of Rabbi Perit. These spellings remain distinct from Hyman’s supplied forms.
